extension_discover.title: Discover extension tools
extension_discover.description: Use first to learn all concrete tools available behind MyTerminal, how to call them, and how to validate/register custom tools.

extension_register.title: Register or edit extension tool
extension_register.description: Validate, upsert, or remove one declarative extension. Validate before upsert. Use extension_discover for the exact registration format.

extension_call.title: Call concrete extension tool
extension_call.description: Invoke any builtin or custom extension by exact name, including arbitrary commands, overwriting writes, and patches. Put tool arguments in input (preferred) or arguments (legacy). Call extension_discover first for its schema.

session_register.title: Start local session
session_register.description: Create a local audit session or delegate a local child session. This only changes MyTerminal session metadata and does not contact external services or modify workspace files.

session_inherit.title: Claim local session
session_inherit.description: Claim an existing MyTerminal session. This only changes local controller metadata.

session_checkpoint.title: Update local session
session_checkpoint.description: Record local session progress. A working checkpoint is not a stopping point; follow any returned continuation instruction immediately.

session_list.title: List local sessions
session_list.description: Read local session metadata without changing files or contacting external services.

session_context.title: Read local session context
session_context.description: Read bounded local continuation context without changing files.

session_history.title: Read local session history
session_history.description: Read paginated local audit history without changing files.

session_release.title: Release local session
session_release.description: Release a local session controller for handoff. This does not delete session history or workspace data.

session_events_ack.title: Acknowledge local events
session_events_ack.description: Mark delivered local session events acknowledged while retaining permanent history.

message_send.title: Send local session message
message_send.description: Send a message between MyTerminal sessions in the same local workspace. It does not contact people or services outside MyTerminal.

message_inbox.title: Read local session inbox
message_inbox.description: Read a bounded page of MyTerminal session messages and optionally mark that page read.

message_conversation.title: Read local session conversation
message_conversation.description: Read a two-way MyTerminal session conversation.

workspace_info.title: Inspect local workspace
workspace_info.description: Read basic metadata for the user-authorized local workspace.

list_dir.title: List local directory
list_dir.description: List one directory inside the user-authorized local workspace without modifying it.

find_files.title: Find local files
find_files.description: Find file paths inside the user-authorized local workspace without modifying them.

search_text.title: Search local text
search_text.description: Search bounded text files inside the user-authorized local workspace without modifying them.

read_file.title: Read local file
read_file.description: Read one bounded file inside the user-authorized local workspace without modifying it.

read_file_range.title: Read local file lines
read_file_range.description: Read a bounded line range inside the user-authorized local workspace without modifying it.

git_status.title: Read Git status
git_status.description: Read Git status in the local workspace without changing the repository.

git_diff.title: Read Git diff
git_diff.description: Read the local Git diff without changing the repository.

git_log.title: Read Git log
git_log.description: Read recent local Git history without changing the repository.

git_show.title: Read Git object
git_show.description: Read one bounded Git object without changing the repository.

blob_create.title: Stage local blob
blob_create.description: Stage content in MyTerminal content-addressed storage without modifying workspace files or contacting external services.

blob_read.title: Read local blob
blob_read.description: Read a bounded staged MyTerminal blob without modifying workspace files.

blob_write_file.title: Create local file from blob
blob_write_file.description: Create a workspace file from a staged blob. Repeating identical content succeeds; different existing content is not overwritten.

_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Running Create local file from blob…
_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Create local file from blob ready

task_poll.title: Poll local task
task_poll.description: Read progress for a MyTerminal task that continued in the background after the 200ms fast-return budget.

subagent_start.title: Start Subagent
subagent_start.description: Start a subagent for a sub-task. Asynchronous: returns taskId immediately; poll with subagent_status; completion arrives via message.

subagent_status.title: Subagent Status
subagent_status.description: Query subagent progress, tasks, cost, and result. On first call after completion, returns the result and cleans up.

subagent_abort.title: Abort Subagent
subagent_abort.description: Abort a running subagent. Idempotent — terminal subagents return their current status.
